method: Drafted from contact sheets (one frame every 10 s), with pause-map, phone-call and cutscene edges checked on 2.5 s sheets. Confirmed by the owner.
note: Times are seconds in the source. Ranges are closed intervals. Anything in neither list is neutral: it counts against precision but is not a bad pick. The 0:00-1:00 'follow the tennis coach' tail is deliberately neutral (owner). Edges not checked on a fine sheet are good to about 5 s.

revisions.rule: A never-pick range runs from the last gameplay frame before it to the first gameplay frame after it, sampled at 0.5 s, so it can only be too wide, never too narrow.
